# Vyre

> Vyre is an open-source, self-hosted home for Claude Code agents. Agents run on a server you
> own, keep working when your laptop is closed, and answer from your Mac (Option-Space, the
> Capsule) or your phone (phone.vyre.run).

## What it is
Vyre is a Claude Code plugin plus one small daemon. It does not fork or wrap Claude Code.

## What runs where
- The daemon (`vyred`) runs on a Linux server you control.
- The Deck (the web app) is served from your own address, `<you>.vyre.run`.
- The Mac Capsule is a small always-on helper on your Mac; press Option-Space to reach it.
- Your Mac reaches your server over Tailscale, which you install and sign in to yourself; Vyre
  never changes your Mac's Tailscale settings. A Linux or Windows desktop you pair joins the
  tailnet on its own; Macs join that way starting in 0.1.2.

## Install
On the Linux server:
```
curl -fsSL https://vyre.run/install.sh | sh
vyre up
```
On your Mac, with Tailscale installed and signed in:
```
npm install -g https://vyre.run/box/vyre.tgz
vyre up
vyre capsule install
```

## Cost
Vyre itself is free and open source. You pay Anthropic for Claude the same way you would running
Claude Code directly.

## Data
Prompts go to Anthropic's API through Claude Code, the same as running Claude Code directly.
Keys, memory and sessions stay on your server. vyre.run holds your name's DNS record and runs
the relay (relay.vyre.run). A phone paired by scanning reaches your server through that relay,
end-to-end encrypted: the relay can see that your phone and server talk, and when, but never
what's said or your keys.
